Tē 76 tô:—Âu-thâu ê āu-bīn lāi-bīn pêng : 1, chih-kut ; 2, chit liap nńg-kut ; 3, kah-chōng-hōe-iām-tiong ê jīm-tài ; 4, kah-chōng-nńg-kut ê siōng-kak ; 5, chit-liap nńg-kut ; 6, 7, phò-lia̍t-nńg-kut ; 8, kah-chōng-nńg-kut ê hā-kak.
Epiglottis, hōe-iām ; Thyro-hy : memb ; kah-chōng - chih-kut -tiong ê jīm ; Thyroid cartilage, kah-chōng-nńg-kut ; Cric. cart., khoân-chōng-nńg-kut. Tī khoân-chōng-nńg-kut ê ē-bīn ū khì-kńg ê thâu nñg lûn (Cunningham).
